description: Independent Lichtenberg II reproduction of 576 cases for the revised method/software manuscripts, with pressure/reference profiles, convergence summaries, integrated forces, 400 levitator height points, execution records, portable validation/plot tools and manuscript identification assets. Original workstation timing aggregates are transcribed and labelled separately; raw timing repetitions, volume meshes and full solver fields are excluded.
